title: Planning Meeting Agenda
excerpt: Council members are invited to review the agenda for the September 1, 2026 planning meeting.
description: Knights of Columbus St. Genevieve Council 14772 will hold its planning meeting on September 1, 2026. Members may review the full agenda below and download the original document.
imageCaption: Knights of Columbus St. Genevieve Council 14772

subitems: Church Drive Kit Cards and Guide are on back order; ordered July 28, 2026. Membership Drive after every 10:30 a.m. Mass on the church premises. Use website link.
3rd Degree Exemplification on September 20, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. at the Lady of Grace in Encino.
Harrah’s Casino turnaround is scheduled for September 5, 2026 (Saturday). PGK Elnor Andal to discuss the attendee list (55 attendees), food and snacks, and a future turnaround.
Update on the Past Grand Knight Dinner/Dance for PGK Elnor C. Andal and all other PGKs on November 21, 2026 (Saturday), including the souvenir program and solicitation letter.
Christmas Party on December 13, 2026 — Bro. Augusto Caritos.
Caroling to be led by Bro. Ryan Amacanin and Bro. CJ Hernandez; dates TBD.
Bowling to be led by Bro. Rolly Maclang; date TBD.

agenda.item: Financial Secretary’s Report and submission of bills to the trustees, including the audit report
Trustees’ Report — Review and approval of bills
agenda.owner: Bro. Filemon Taleon, Bro. Freddie Sotto, and PGK Elnor C. Andal

subitems: Faith Director — Bro. Dom Magtahas: update on Into the Breach, Rosary, Holy Hour, and S. Gifts.
Family Director — Bro. Augusto Caritos: update on Family Week, Family Prayer Night, and KCC.
Community Director — Bro. Elnor C. Andal: update on Free Throw, Soccer, Coats, and Wheel Cr.
Life Director — Bro. Don Calvo: update on Pregnancy Ctr, Novena Life, March Life, and Spcl Nds.
Membership Director — Bro. Primo Sumagaysay: update on recruitment and Kits.
Social Media Chairman — Bro. Bon Mendoza: update on newsletter, website, and Facebook.

agenda.item: Presentation and motion for approval of the Council Budget for Columbian Year 2026–2027 (not approved at the last Business Meeting)
4th Degree matters: Installation of Officers and Call Outs
Other possible events for the Columbian Year: Bowling Event

title: Happy Birthday to Our August Celebrants
excerpt: Happy birthday to our active council members celebrating their birthdays throughout August!
description: St. Genevieve Council 14772 sends warm birthday wishes to all of our active members celebrating in August. May your special day and the year ahead be filled with faith, fellowship, happiness, and many blessings.
imageAlt: Happy Birthday greeting for the August celebrants of St. Genevieve Council 14772
imageCaption: Birthday greeting for our August celebrants
contributionNote: Please coordinate with Bro. Mon De Guzman if you would like to donate food. All other members are encouraged to give monetary donations.
donationThanks: Thank you to Bro. Rolly Maclang for the generous $100 food donation.

title: Council Photo Op
excerpt: Council members are invited to a Photo Op at the 10:30 a.m. Mass. Suit and tie are required.
description: Knights of Columbus St. Genevieve Council 14772 invites council members to join the Council Photo Op at the 10:30 a.m. Mass. Please arrive dressed in a suit and tie.
imageAlt: Council Photo Op announcement for August 16, 2026 at the 10:30 a.m. Mass; suit and tie required
location: St. Genevieve Church, 14061 Roscoe Blvd., Panorama City, CA 91402

title: Installation of Officers and Directors
excerpt: Join Council 14772 for Mass and the installation of officers and directors for Columbian Year 2026–2027, followed by a dinner dance celebration.
description: Knights of Columbus Council 14772 welcomes members, families, and friends to the installation of officers and directors for Columbian Year 2026–2027. The evening begins with Mass and continues with a dinner dance at Madonna Hall, celebrating brotherhood and service.
imageAlt: Flyer for the Council 14772 Installation of Officers and Directors on August 8, 2026
schedule: Dinner dance celebration immediately following Mass
location: St. Genevieve Church, Madonna Hall, 14061 Roscoe Blvd., Panorama City, CA 91402

title: Harrah’s Casino Turnaround Fundraising Event
excerpt: Support Council 14772 at a Harrah’s Casino turnaround fundraiser, with bus transportation departing Panorama City at 8:00 a.m.
description: Knights of Columbus St. Genevieve Council 14772 invites supporters to a Harrah’s Casino turnaround fundraising event. The chartered bus will leave promptly from the Panorama City post office. Participation supports the council’s charitable and community work.
imageAlt: Flyer for the Harrah’s Casino Turnaround Fundraising Event on September 5, 2026
location: In front of the post office, 14416 Chase Street, Panorama City, CA 91402
